name: smart-home-rules-tests
description: Realtime Database emulator tests for production and PROPOSED security rules. Nothing here deploys rules.

scripts.test:proposed: firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-smart-home --config firebase.test.json "node --test test/proposed.test.js"
scripts.test:lifecycle: firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-smart-home --config firebase.test.json "node --test test/lifecycle.test.js"
scripts.test:device-client: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database --project demo-smart-home --config firebase.test.json "node --test test/device_client.integration.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:proposed && npm run test:lifecycle && npm run test:device-client
